title: VisualFissionBundle
description: Output contract for 100x-visual-fission. Self-contained in this skill (no shared cross-skill schemas/ in this repo yet). Locked person/scene/product identity in -> a media-fission plan (which frame-structure: single_frame/head_tail/head_mid_tail/multi_day) + N distinct prompt_sets (VTP step 04) + camera-preset x aspect-ratio fission_variants per frame (VTP step 06) + one fixed negative_prompt constant (VTP step 07, reproduced from the framework doc). NOTE (same split as 100x-search-query/100x-persona): vanilla JSON Schema draft-07 -- even with if/then/const, which this file uses aggressively for the many FIXED deterministic tables VTP defines (camera-variant A/B/C -> lighting/color keywords, aspect_ratio -> resolution, media structure -> frame_count) -- structurally CANNOT express: (a) an array's length must equal a sibling numeric field (frames.length === media_plan.frame_count), (b) ordering/sequence constraints across array items (frame roles must appear in the right order; multi_day day_index must be strictly ascending and distinct; and which day-role frame counts as the reference-anchor 'first' frame is whichever one has the smallest day_index in the array -- day_index is a real source-narrative day number, not a re-indexed 1..N placeholder, so this cannot be reduced to a per-item day_index==1 check),(c) referential integrity from one array's foreign-key-shaped string/int back to another array's actual defined keys (fission_variants[].source_prompt_set_id must be a real prompt_sets[].id; frame_role/day_index must be a real media_plan.frames[] entry), (d) coverage/zero-orphan checks (every planned frame must be referenced by >=1 fission_variant), (e) cross-field byte-equality between two DIFFERENT array branches (every fission_variant's prompt_json.negative_prompt must equal the top-level negative_prompt), (f) case-insensitive content screening against a curated word list (the axiom-4 unvisualizable-claim scan). All six are enforced by scripts/validate.js, which loads this file at runtime so the two never drift apart. See axioms.md for the full split.

product_name.description: Echo of the input product/persona name. Must not be a real customer/brand identifier when used in this repo's evals/ (synthetic only).

category.description: Generic taxonomy category (e.g. 保健品/家居/美妆个护/3C/通用), never a customer-specific category dictionary entry.

source_material_note.description: Optional. Discloses whether the person/scene references behind `constants` were real vision-reversed JSON (VTP steps 01/02) or a degraded text-only description (no images available). Does not change the output contract -- see workflow.md Phase 1 class-A degrade path.

constants.description: Axiom 1 identity lock. These three anchors are the 'constants' half of VTP step 03 (extract-common): they must read as a real, specific description (schema bans a closed set of vague placeholders, see identity_anchor), and scripts/validate.js checks they appear as a literal case-insensitive substring inside EVERY prompt_sets[].combined_prompt and EVERY fission_variants[].prompt_json.prompt -- the actual, runnable enforcement of 'constants never change across a fission branch', which is the whole point of calling this axis a constant.

variables.description: The 'variables' half of VTP step 03 (extract-common), at leaf-field granularity -- e.g. dimension:camera, name:'framing', observed_values:['close-up','medium shot'].

prompt_sets.description: VTP step 04 (generate-variants) output: N distinct prompt sets, each tagged with >=2 axis_tags. scripts/validate.js checks all combined_prompt values are pairwise distinct (no copy-paste duplicate) and that every one contains the three constants.* identity anchors.

fission_variants.description: VTP step 06 (meta-prompt) output, extended with the media-fission axis (axiom 2): each item renders ONE prompt_set at ONE media_plan frame, under ONE fixed camera_variant (A/B/C, VTP's original 3-preset table) and ONE aspect_ratio. scripts/validate.js checks referential integrity (source_prompt_set_id and frame_role/day_index must point at real entries), zero-orphan frame coverage, and negative_prompt byte-equality against the top-level constant.

negative_prompt.const: blurry, low quality, distorted, extra fingers, extra limbs, watermark, cartoon, illustration, anime, 3D render, oversaturated, plastic skin, oversmoothed, stock image feel, ring light, studio lighting, flash, artificial lighting, neon
negative_prompt.description: VTP step 07 (negative-prompt). The content is reproduced from the framework documentation section 'negative prompt怎么写'; fixed constant, user cannot edit (axiom 4).

based_on_media_structure.description: Must equal media_plan.structure -- schema.json cannot express this top-level-to-nested-field equality (cross-field), scripts/validate.js checks it.

media_structure_enum.description: Axiom 2 (media fission). single_frame = 1 frame (no stacking). head_tail = 2 frames (首尾, quick before/after). head_mid_tail = 3 frames (首中尾, effect-stacking with a mid transition action). multi_day = 4-8 frames (数日见效, sequential day-by-day progression). Source: 功效堆叠与多帧结构.md.

camera_variant_enum.description: VTP's original fixed 3-preset table (vtp_prompts_06-meta-prompt.md 'Variant Definitions'): A=35mm/eye-level/medium/natural-window/warm, B=50mm/low-angle/medium/ring-light/neutral, C=85mm/high-angle/close-up/overcast-natural/muted. Not expanded in media fission -- axiom 2 adds the media_structure axis ON TOP of this table, it does not replace or add a 4th camera preset.

identity_anchor.pattern: ^(?!.*(某处|某人|某个地方|随便|待定|不确定|TBD|tbd|somewhere|Somewhere|SOMEWHERE|anywhere|Anywhere|ANYWHERE|unspecified|Unspecified|UNSPECIFIED|placeholder|Placeholder|PLACEHOLDER|generic|Generic|GENERIC)).{3,}$
identity_anchor.description: Must not be a closed-set vague placeholder (reuses 100x-persona axiom-3's vague-word-ban technique, applied here to identity anchors instead of scene coordinates). JSON Schema draft-07 `pattern` has no case-insensitive flag, so every banned English word is enumerated in all three forms actually seen in real generation output (lower/Title/ALL-CAPS) -- an earlier version of this pattern only listed lower/Title-Case and let e.g. 'GENERIC'/'ANYWHERE'/'PLACEHOLDER'/'SOMEWHERE' (all-caps) through undetected; fixed by adding the missing ALL-CAPS form for every word in the list.

frame_item.description: uses_first_frame_as_reference operationalizes 功效堆叠与多帧结构.md's key rule '尾图务必写(使用首图作为参考)...其余保持不变' -- every frame after the first must lock back to frame 1. For role:head this schema fixes the value directly (const false). For role:day (multi_day), which frame counts as 'first' is NOT hardcoded to day_index==1 here -- day_index holds the REAL source-narrative day number (e.g. a source that only ever mentions day 3/7/14/30 must keep those literal numbers, never a re-indexed 1..N placeholder), so 'first' means whichever day-role frame has the SMALLEST day_index in the array, which may not be 1. Determining that requires comparing day_index across every frame in the array -- a cross-item comparison vanilla JSON Schema cannot express (no keyword can single out 'the array item with the minimum value of field X'). The rule is enforced entirely by scripts/validate.js's dayFrameFirstReferenceCheck.

structure_justification.description: Must point back to a timeline/narrative cue in the input (axiom 2). Known gap: schema can only force a digit to be cited when structure=multi_day (see allOf below); it cannot verify the digit genuinely reflects the source narrative and not a fabricated one -- see axioms.md #2 TODO.

axis_tags.description: Self-declared axes this prompt_set deliberately varies on (VTP step 04's 'each must vary on 2+ axes' rule).

prompt.pattern: ^(?=.*shot on iPhone)(?=.*visible pores)(?=.*natural skin texture)(?=.*minor imperfections)(?=.*photorealistic).+$
prompt.description: Must contain VTP step 06's fixed realism suffix (all 5 substrings, any order). Axiom 4's unvisualizable-claim word ban is NOT checked here (case-insensitive scan is not practically expressible as a vanilla-regex pattern without an unreadable per-letter case-alternation) -- scripts/validate.js does that check.

negative_prompt.description: Must byte-equal the top-level negative_prompt const -- schema.json cannot express cross-branch field equality to a sibling top-level property from inside an array item, scripts/validate.js checks it.

fission_variant_item.description: resolution is locked to aspect_ratio (VTP 06's Resolution Map) and prompt must literally reflect its camera_variant's fixed lighting/color-grading keywords (VTP 06's Variant Definitions table) -- all via if/then, since both are fixed deterministic lookup tables schema.json CAN express. Each keyword lookahead is wrapped in \b word boundaries: an earlier version used bare substring lookaheads ((?=.*natural-window)(?=.*warm)), which a longer unrelated word could satisfy without containing the actual keyword as a whole word (e.g. 'natural-windowsill nearby, warmth in her smile' satisfied the old A-variant pattern via substring containment even though neither 'natural-window' nor 'warm' appears as its own token) -- fixed by requiring each keyword to appear as a bounded whole word/phrase, not merely as a substring of a longer word.
